description: A peer heard during the idle wait only in a burst addressed to another node is not in communication with this node: at expiry the soft link is closed as idle.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ at 0. As sis-session/idle-heard-partial up to 85000: the soft link is established at 57550 with an idle time of 90000, the peer's DATA-ONLY FSN 0 at 61000 restarts the wait to 151000 (A-0320), and our ACK-ONLY ends at 83550. At 85000 a burst from the peer begins; at 86000 its DATA-ONLY FSN 1 (C_PDU start, EOT 10) arrives addressed to 0.0.1.4, another node: it is not for us, so the DTS acts on it no further (C-0838) and no acknowledgement is owed. Its header is valid (C-0833) and its EOT predicts the channel busy until 91000 (K-0073), but with nothing queued no csma.vdcd_end runs. The burst ends at 87000 with no output. At 151000 the idle wait expires. The peer was heard during it, but not addressing this node, so it was not communicating with us and the link is idle (A-0320): the SIS closes it with Idle Soft Link Terminated (A-0196, A-0205), sis.soft_link_max stops, and with nothing outstanding and no acknowledgement owed the CAS goes straight to Step 1 (B-0317, B-0421): link_state breaking. The last burst on the channel was the peer's, addressed to another node, so LBT rule 1 does not apply (K-0067, K-0072), and its end was predicted by its EOT, later than DCD fell, so LBT is the VDCD value, 3000. The rest of the break is as sis-session/idle-break. Fixture and addresses as sis-session/idle-break.
